insights.note: Breakdown of all 63 submitted applications by role type and by company, compiled from the full campaign log. Session update (2026-08-03, fresh search cycle): per user request, ran a full search-and-apply cycle across LinkedIn, Naukri, Foundit and Indeed for Operations Manager / Team Leader / Customer Service Manager roles. No genuinely new matches were found - LinkedIn (Operations Manager, Team Leader Operations, Team Leader BPO, India, past 24h) returned near-identical result sets across all three queries dominated by mismatched domains (hospitality, civil engineering, IT infra) or entry-level postings. Naukri (Operations Manager broad search, and Team Leader Operations in Kolkata, 5+ yrs) surfaced overwhelmingly 0-5yr entry-level, retail/insurance-sales, or unrelated-domain roles. Foundit (Team Leader Operations, Kolkata) resurfaced Titanium Consulting's US Healthcare Team Leader/Operations Manager and TP Health's Process Trainer, both already investigated and skipped in prior sessions as domain mismatches. Indeed (Operations Manager BPO, India, last 24h) surfaced 6 results: BT's People & Culture Professional (HR Business Partner role, mismatch), Aanvii Hearing Solutions' Team Lead-HCA (hearing-aid sales, low salary, mismatch), EXL's Lead Assistant Manager HCA (healthcare-specific), MetLife's Senior Manager-Operations (actually a Finance Technology/Workday ERP role, mismatch), Sara Infotech's manager-Healthcare BPO (US healthcare patient-communication domain, mismatch, same pattern as prior Titanium Consulting skip), and two Qode (fintech PPI wallet) roles - Lead-Customer Operations & Support (L2) and Manager-Business Operations Support (L2 & Cross-Functional) - both requiring specific RBI Ombudsman/Nodal Officer/PPI wallet regulatory grievance-handling experience that Resume_4 does not demonstrate, so both were skipped as genuine domain mismatches rather than applied to speculatively. No new applications submitted this session; counts unchanged (applied 83, rejected 32, awaiting 51, blocked 18). Rejection check (2026-08-03, continued): searched Gmail for rejection-pattern language after 2026-07-28. Found one genuine new rejection - ShipBob's 'Manager, Control Tower' role, rejected 2026-08-03 ('we have decided to move forward with other candidates'). This application (submitted 2026-07-22, confirmed via ShipBob's 'Thank you for applying' email) had never been logged in recentApplications or counted in the applied total, so it was backfilled as both applied and rejected in the same update. Fresh Prints' Order Processing Associate rejection was also re-surfaced by the search but was already logged (2026-08-01). No other genuine rejections found among 11 matches - the rest were application-confirmation/status emails (DHL, Amazon assessment, Wipro, UPS, HDFC Bank) or unrelated newsletters, not rejections. Applied count updated 83->84 (ShipBob backfill), rejected updated 32->33, awaiting unchanged at 51. Full Gmail reconciliation (2026-08-03): per user request, rebuilt the applied and awaiting lists from scratch by auditing Gmail across all of 2026 and cross-checking against each platform's own application-history page. Gmail searches covered ATS/company confirmation language ('thank you for applying', 'application received', 'we have received your application', 'application submitted') plus platform-specific confirmations from LinkedIn (jobs-noreply), Indeed (indeedapply), Naukri (info@naukri.com 'You applied for N jobs'), and foundit/Monster ('Application Successful'). Because Naukri's multi-job confirmation emails only render the first role in the message body, and LinkedIn's confirmations name only the company and not the role, the role/company/date detail was completed from LinkedIn's My Jobs > Applied tracker (44 entries, 37 of them in 2026) and Naukri's Application History page (43 total applies: 35 on-Naukri + 8 external web jobs). RESULT: 142 verified applications in 2026, versus the 84 previously recorded - the dashboard had been tracking only the applications made during these Claude sessions plus a handful of backfills, and was missing roughly 58 earlier applications the user had submitted independently (notably a large block of AML/transaction-monitoring roles applied via Naukri in May-July, the Amazon.jobs internal applications, and a set of direct-ATS applications to HSBC, Capgemini, Goldman Sachs, OpenAI, Scale AI, FedEx, Pearson, Wise, Holafly, AML RightSource and others). Each application is now stored in a new 'applications' array carrying company, role, date, source platform and a status of either 'rejected' or 'awaiting'; the applications with no rejection email are additionally mirrored into a new 'awaiting' array so the dashboard can render applied and awaiting separately. Nine further applications are recorded that were evidenced only by their rejection email with no surviving confirmation (five Revolut FinCrime roles, three JPMorgan Chase roles, and Microsoft's Logistics Technician) - their dates are the rejection date less a short interval and should be treated as approximate. Seven Indeed applications from 2026-07-19 are logged with the role title only, because Indeed's confirmation emails do not name the employer. Counts updated: applied 84->142, rejected held at 33 (the Gmail rejection audit found no additional rejections), awaiting 51->109, blocked unchanged at 18. Scope was limited to 2026 per user instruction; pre-2026 applications visible in LinkedIn's tracker (Beam, Bookspert, Allcargo Logistics, WhiteSlips, SVF Entertainment, Triple, Concentrix) were deliberately excluded as out of campaign scope. Email mapping (2026-08-03): every entry in the applications and awaiting arrays now carries a gmailLink pointing at its own confirmation email, matching how the rejections tab already worked - 124 of 142 link straight to the 'thank you for applying' / 'application sent' message from the employer, ATS or job board. Nine further entries (five Revolut FinCrime roles, three JPMorgan Chase roles, Microsoft Logistics Technician) link to their rejection email instead and are tagged with an emailNote, because no confirmation email survives for them. The remaining nine (Flexiple x2, Barclays, Amazon Last Mile, Wipro, Clearview Capital Advisors, TP Team Lead, Care Health Insurance, TP Vision) were submitted through in-session portal flows that never sent a confirmation email and are tagged accordingly. Note that Naukri batches several same-day applications into one confirmation email, so a few Naukri entries share a gmailLink. One additional genuine rejection was discovered during this mapping pass and added: HSBC Group's Wealth Operations Executive (Job ID 43808), rejected 2026-06-03 - its template opens with 'Thank you for applying' before the regret language, which is why earlier keyword sweeps had classified it as a confirmation. Counts updated: rejected 33->34, awaiting 109->108, applied unchanged at 142.
